hints.content:
The point $(1,-2)$ lies in the shaded area of both of the inequalities.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A coordinate plane with a graphed system of inequalities. The x- and y-axes both scale by one. There is a dashed line representing an inequality that goes through the points zero, zero and three, one. The shaded region for the inequality is below the line. There is a solid line representing the second inequality that goes through the points zero, two and three, one. The shaded region for this inequality is below the line. The point one, negative two is plotted inside of the shaded region of both inequalities.

hints.content: Yes, $(1,-2)$ is a solution of the system of inequalities.
